detail: Stewarded one bounded Graveyard Shift ordinary-Borough conversion after sealed v0.18.0-every-window-assembly. Preserved high-population grouped-army control, no workers, automatic scouting, casualty Essence, field summons, spread economy, no routine siege, and hexbound.coop-command/v2.

Converted only Graveyard Shift Borough presentation into Last-Rites Exchange while preserving Z, 80 Glow, 75 Scrap, four-second build, 560 durability, income, and +80 cap. A positive formation casualty within 520 receives 55% extra Essence for the casualty formation's side through the strongest eligible completed living Exchange.

Existing mixed-charter diversity scales the local dividend through the capped x1.45 network from 55% to 79.75%. Buildings, invalid or zero-death events, unfinished, destroyed, hostile, and out-of-range sources are excluded; overlapping Exchanges never stack.

Normal combat and hazard casualties now share awardCasualtyEssence. Player dividends credit shared Essence; rival dividends credit enemyEssence. The existing 60-Essence rival ghost audit was factored through cashRivalEssence and can spend both Wake Dividends and Boo stipend income.

Added bone-ledger, abacus, skull, and LAST RITES facade treatment plus an active receipt ring, slips, and post-formation dark plaques reading WAKE DIVIDEND +55% and the exact credited LAST RITES +0.6 ESS. The post-formation overlay fixes the first visual layering seam without changing gameplay.

Wonderwork-first rival expansion remains unchanged; after two Graveyard Wonderworks, ordinary expansion resolves Last-Rites Exchanges. Rival dividend income stays in the rival account and is spendable. No AI-only multiplier, manual harvest action, worker, siege unit, individual-fighter control, or protocol field was added.

Focused faction-district coverage passed 18/18, including unchanged ordinary values, 520 range, 55% local dividend, capped x1.45 scaling to 79.75%, strongest-only non-stacking, building and source exclusions, player/rival account routing, combat and hazard integration, spendable rival income, and Wonderwork-first expansion parity.

Five runtime syntax checks passed; full Node deterministic, HTTP, and relay suite passed 70/70; package contract passed 69/69; isolated HTTP suite passed 4/4 and reported the complete v0.19 health and launcher metadata contract.

At 1280x720 in a Mild Tuesday Graveyard Shift skirmish, repeated same-viewport frames proved completed baseline, automatic active Wake Dividend, and settled recovery. The active frame showed the receipt ring and slips, WAKE DIVIDEND +55%, and LAST RITES +0.6 ESS; the settled frame cleared temporary cues while the Exchange remained. Browser warning/error logs were empty.

The browser exposed repeated exact-viewport screenshots but no visual.capture.ephemeral-rolling-buffer/v1 hand, so exact sub-frame animation cadence remains UNKNOWN. Retained JPEGs are native-verified 1280x720 with distinct SHA-256 digests.

Two exact deletion attempts were policy-rejected. evidence/visual-temp-last-rites-v19, evidence/visual-temp-last-rites-v19-guard, and evidence/visual-temp-last-rites-v19-story remain isolated TEMPORARY_CAPTURE directories and are not cited for promotion. The historical denied Faction Formations temporary capture was left untouched; no bypass or broader target was attempted.

Externally owned Node PID 20208 serves current v0.19 static assets and the served game data contains last-rites-exchange. Its unrestarted in-memory health metadata still reports v0.14.0-spectral-census with three conversions. Isolated HTTP tests prove v0.19 metadata without misclaiming the live listener or restarting an external process.
